responsibility: This module is the C/C++ host-support library layer for GNU Modula-2, providing the runtime-facing bridges that let Modula-2 code use operating-system, libc, and low-level utility services in a portable way. Its files wrap command-line and environment capture, getopt processing, temporary-file selection, errno access, termios control, select-style I/O waiting, signal-based exception delivery, numeric string conversion for double and long double, miscellaneous libc/POSIX helpers, and fallback host math or string routines where system facilities are missing or poisoned. It also includes the small M2RTS interface contract and several stub or dummy implementations for module linking, coroutine/interrupt support, and bootstrap tool support, so the gm2 runtime can register modules, satisfy expected entry points, and continue to build or run on hosts without full optional runtime facilities.
